description: Starter ontology of everyday objects/products for material-world synthetic data generation.
notes: These are everyday objects that can plausibly appear with multiple materials.
Use these object cards to generate object-material scenario plans.
Final training exports should contain natural prose only, not this metadata.
The candidate_materials field includes common materials plus useful counterfactual materials for teaching material-conditioned dynamics.

objects.everyday_function: holds liquid for drinking
good_material_contrasts: glass cup dropped -> cracks or shatters
rubber cup dropped -> bends or bounces
metal cup dropped -> dents or rings
paper cup filled with water -> softens or leaks
wax cup near heat -> softens
